summary: Make Affiliate Status and Party Code mandatory when Account Type = Reinsurer and Ownership = Owned

description.raw: User Story: As a Product Owner / Data Owner I want Affiliate/Non-Affiliate and Party Code to be mandatory on Account records when Account Type = Reinsurer and Ownership = Owned So that every Owned Reinsurer account has required identity data for processing, reporting and downstream systems and no such account can be saved without both values Description / Scope: When an Account is classified as Reinsurer (Account Type = Reinsurer) AND Ownership = Owned, the fields Affiliate/Non-Affiliate and Party Code must be required. This applies to creates and updates via UI, API, integrations and automated processes.  Acceptance Criteria (GIVEN / WHEN / THEN): Mandatory on Create (UI) GIVEN a user creates a new Account WHEN Account Type = Reinsurer AND Ownership = Owned AND Affiliate/Non-Affiliate or Party Code is blank THEN the save is blocked and the user sees the error: "Affiliate/Non-Affiliate Status and Party Code are required for Owned Reinsurer accounts." Mandatory on Edit (UI) GIVEN an existing Account where Account Type = Reinsurer AND Ownership = Owned WHEN a user attempts to save the record with Affiliate/Non-Affiliate or Party Code blank THEN the save is blocked and the user sees the same error message. Mandatory on API / Integrations / Automation GIVEN an API call, integration or automated job attempts to create or update an Account with Account Type = Reinsurer AND Ownership = Owned and Affiliate/Non-Affiliate or Party Code is blank WHEN the operation runs THEN the operation is rejected with a validation error and the event is logged; integrations must provide both fields or run under a controlled bypass.
